cues: A conservator repairs a torn binding with Japanese tissue, then lets the volume dry beneath light weights.
At a book fair, visitors compare translated editions before choosing a title for their reading group.
A poetry reading begins with the moderator introducing each contributor before audience questions start.
Fermentation begins when yeast consumes sugars, releasing carbon dioxide that slowly expands the dough.
At dawn, a gardener prunes dead stems and waters seedlings before the afternoon heat arrives.
The mechanic drains old oil, replaces the filter, and checks the engine for leaks.
